# Rule reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-checks/catalogue/rules.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

A rule checks one property of a project and reports findings with the rule's ID, for example `EW-TERM-002`. Rules are grouped in packs; a check scheme selects the rules a run executes. This reference lists the 40 shipped rules of the rule registry, one page per pack, from the catalogue snapshot [`crates/ew-checks/catalogue/rules.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/crates/ew-checks/catalogue/rules.json). The rule catalogue of the design is [doc 15 §4](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/15-checks-revisions-collaboration.md#4-rule-catalogue).

What a page does not hold yet: the message text (the engine builds each message at run time from the records it names), the quick fix, the standard reference by number and clause, an example and waiver guidance (NFR-DOC-02). They arrive with the Fluent messages of the rules; until then each pack page links its section of the catalogue.

## Schemes

| Scheme | Purpose | Lenient |
|---|---|---|
| `drafting` | default online scheme while editing | no |
| `full` | audits and acceptance of hygiene rules | no |
| `migration` | lenient run behind a migration report | yes |
| `pre-delivery` | release scheme; ew check --scheme pre-delivery | no |
